name: Windows Local Administrator Password Solution (LAPS) Enabled
description: Ensures Windows LAPS (BackupDirectory 1 = Microsoft Entra ID or 2 = Active Directory, set by CSP or Group Policy) or legacy Microsoft LAPS (AdmPwdEnabled = 1) manages a unique, rotated local administrator password, preventing lateral movement with a shared local password.

validation.command: reg query HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Policies\LAPS /v BackupDirectory; reg query HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\LAPS /v BackupDirectory; reg query "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft Services\AdmPwd" /v AdmPwdEnabled
